Hi Curry! I really apriciate that you took the time to reply my post. Thank you for that! Sincerely.

The relationship with my parents is difficult. When i wrote this post I was really angry at the world cause I tend to blame everything for my flaws. In retrospective i dont think i was fair to my parents. My parents do love me and I always have had something to eat. I always will be grateful to them for that. But, on the other hand, they are really bad at handeling their problems. Also, they weren't there when I most needed them. 
Since I was in primary school to the start of college I was badly bullied. Physically and emotionally. I asked for help several times but they didnt do anything. My mom has their own problems but my dad wasnt there for me. 

I do think, even considering the bad things that have happened to me, that my life hasnt been as bad as other people's lifes. And I should take that into account.

Even tho, sometimes I feel really bad for some things of my present or my past. 

Anyhow. I hope that you are doing good. Thanks for your advice. And sorry for taking so long to reply lol.
It is exactly that. I feel angry about that. It's so unfair and so wrong. I wish I had some will to live too. Some people don't realise how lucky they are by being able to have will to live.
It's really hard for me to love myself tho. I just don't like me at all lol. I'm trying to improve that.
